notes: TTFO criterion is measured only for adapters exposing streaming_cadence; one-shot-only libraries structurally fail it.
Fidelity is preliminary here; tests/conformance differential harness owns exact conformance scoring.

thresholds.async: missed_beat_pct <2% and max_delay_ms <15ms on every tier
thresholds.rss: one-shot path <=3x input bytes; streaming candidate <=256MiB constant on xlarge
thresholds.throughput: warm throughput >=5x markdownify on medium+ and >=20 MiB/s on large/xlarge
thresholds.ttfo: streaming only: first chunk <=50ms and max inter-chunk gap <=100ms on large/xlarge

manifest_naming: fixtures.lock.json is the canonical fixture manifest; no separate fixtures/manifest.json is used.

residual: This is the incumbent oracle; residual divergences are assigned to other adapters.

targets.code_language: do not inject synthetic code fence language
targets.heading_style: ATX headings for comparability with Rust candidates

residual: May emit reference-style or otherwise normalized links differently from markdownify.

targets.wrap: avoid line-wrap confound in throughput/fidelity output
